arguments.content:
-- Migration: add the new loyalty column to customers and backfill it
-- from legacy_code using the code -> tier mapping in codes.csv.

-- 1) Add the new loyalty column.
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

-- 2) Backfill it from legacy_code.
UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
  END
WHERE legacy_code IS NOT NULL;
